name: Mirage Raceway
summary: Rocket cars race across the salt flats at Mirage Raceway. Goblin tinkerer Pozzik and gnome engineer Fizzle Brassbolts test their machines as Horde and Alliance supporters gather to wager and cheer.

sections.title: Speed, Salt, and Rivalry
sections.body: Across the white salt flats, Pozzik and Fizzle Brassbolts keep up their fierce rivalry. The goblin tinkerer and gnome engineer each built a rocket-powered drag car, then gathered a crew to race it in daily showdowns. Their contest draws invention, sabotage, and testing to the flats. Each crew hunts for a mechanical advantage.

sections.title: A Neutral Crossroads
sections.body: Horde and Alliance supporters gather at the raceway. Spectators cheer for gnome precision or goblin firepower, while gamblers and shady opportunists thrive on wagers over the results. The camps also serve as a busy trading depot for travelers journeying between Thousand Needles and the blazing sands of Tanaris.

faq.answer: Across the salt flats of Thousand Needles, rocket cars race at Mirage Raceway. Rival engineers built the strip to prove whether goblin or gnome mechanics are superior.
Gnome engineer Fizzle Brassbolts and goblin tinkerer Pozzik maintain the track together. Each has a crew and workshop along the raceway, where they field competing rocket cars.

faq.q: Can Horde and Alliance both use this area?
faq.answer: Yes. Horde and Alliance supporters gather at Mirage Raceway to cheer for their favorites, wager on races, and aid the rival engineering crews.

faq.q: Why race out in the salt flats?
faq.answer: The Shimmering Flats provide a smooth, wide, open surface. Miles of room let rocket cars reach top speeds and slow down safely.

angles.text: For tinkerers of any faction, Mirage Raceway brings goblin risk-taking against gnomish meticulous design. Its crews field-test raw speed, volatile fuel, and experimental vehicle parts.
As a gnome, you can see Fizzle Brassbolts fly the banner of Gnomeregan here. He relies on fellow gnomes and allies to prove disciplined innovation outperforms reckless goblin combustion.
